name: gmail_watch
description: Runs automatically every hour to check Gmail, summarize what's new, and ALWAYS speak up when something is important or time-sensitive; silent only when everything is routine.
instructions:
1. Call mcp_gmail_search_emails with query "is:unread newer_than:2d" to check for new email. Mail an earlier check already saw is left out automatically; never bring up an email you reported before.
2. Summarize it in a couple of sentences. 
3. Judge whether anything is genuinely important or time-sensitive: a real person (personal message) needing a reply, a deadline, a security/account alert (new sign-in, password reset, suspicious activity), a payment/billing problem, or anything urgent - versus routine newsletters/promos/automated notifications. 
4. Do NOT call remember_fact for this check: every check is already in the audit trail, and a memory per check crowds out real facts about the user. 5. If your summary identifies ANY important or time-sensitive email, your final reply MUST be a short spoken alert naming who it is from and what it is about (one to three sentences) - never leave the reply empty in that case, and never save the finding only to memory. 
6. Only if everything is routine or unimportant, give NO spoken reply at all - respond with empty text, since this is a silent background check. When unsure whether something is important, lean towards speaking.
start_line: Checking your Gmail for anything new since the last check.
